notes.general_comments:
6987 candidates sat this paper. The mean mark was 20.5 which was slightly lower than both the mean of
21.2 in June 2014 and the mean of 21.9 in June 2013.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 4, 22 and 27. These questions
were answered correctly by 85% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of the syllabus and
were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 3, 11 and 24. These
questions were answered correctly by fewer than 45% of the candidates.
There were no questions which were answered incorrectly by candidates who scored well on the test overall.
(If this were to be the case then it may indicate that those who scored well on the test overall might have
seen an alternative, and possible, interpretation of the question which could possibly indicate a fault in the
question).
0455 Economics June 2015
